<!-- Generated by scripts/lua_types_to_starlight.py from the typings of pmm_skill_system. Do not edit. -->

Call them with `exports.pmm_skill_system:<Name>(...)`.

## Client-side Exports

### AddExpClient

Add experience to a skill (client side)

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:AddExpClient(skillID, amount)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `skillID` | `string` | The unique identifier of the skill |
| `amount` | `number` | The amount of experience to add |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `success` | `boolean` | Whether the experience was added successfully |

### GetSkillDataClient

Get the skill data of the player. Without `skillID` it returns every skill, keyed by skill id

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:GetSkillDataClient(skillID)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `skillID` | `string\|nil` | The unique identifier of the skill |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `skillData` | `table<string, PMMSkillData>\|PMMSkillData\|nil` | The skill data, or nil if not found |

## Server-side Exports

### AddExpServer

Add experience to a skill (server side), showing the "+XP" notification

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:AddExpServer(src, skillID, amount)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `src` | `number` | The player source/server ID |
| `skillID` | `string` | The unique identifier of the skill |
| `amount` | `number` | The amount of experience to add |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `success` | `boolean` | Whether the experience was added successfully |

### AddExpServerSilent

Add experience to a skill (server side) without the "+XP" notification

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:AddExpServerSilent(src, skillID, amount)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `src` | `number` | The player source/server ID |
| `skillID` | `string` | The unique identifier of the skill |
| `amount` | `number` | The amount of experience to add |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `success` | `boolean` | Whether the experience was added successfully |

### GetSkillDataServer

Get the skill data of a player. Without `skillID` it returns every skill, keyed by skill id

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:GetSkillDataServer(src, skillID)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `src` | `number` | The player source/server ID |
| `skillID` | `string\|nil` | The unique identifier of the skill |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `skillData` | `table<string, PMMSkillData>\|PMMSkillData\|nil` | The skill data, or nil if not found |

### GetSkillLevelByCharId

Get the current level of a skill reading it from the DB (works for offline characters too)

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:GetSkillLevelByCharId(charID, skillID)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `charID` | `number` | The character identifier |
| `skillID` | `string` | The unique identifier of the skill |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `level` | `number` | The current level, 0 if the character never gained exp in the skill |

### HasGainedExpRecently

Check if a player gained EXP in the last N seconds

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:HasGainedExpRecently(src, seconds)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `src` | `number` | The player source/server ID |
| `seconds` | `number` | The time window in seconds |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `gained` | `boolean` | Whether the player gained EXP in the time window |

## Shared Exports (client and server)

### GetSkillLevel

Get the current level of a skill

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:GetSkillLevel(skillData, skillID)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `skillData` | `table<string, PMMSkillData>\|PMMSkillData\|nil` | The skill data object |
| `skillID` | `string` | The unique identifier of the skill |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `level` | `number` | The current level of the skill, 0 if not found |

### GetSkillExp

Get the current experience points of a skill

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:GetSkillExp(skillData, skillID)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `skillData` | `table<string, PMMSkillData>\|PMMSkillData\|nil` | The skill data object |
| `skillID` | `string` | The unique identifier of the skill |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `experience` | `number` | The current experience points of the skill, 0 if not found |

### CheckSkillLevel

Check if a skill has reached or exceeded a specific level

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:CheckSkillLevel(skillData, skillID, level)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `skillData` | `table<string, PMMSkillData>\|PMMSkillData\|nil` | The skill data object |
| `skillID` | `string` | The unique identifier of the skill |
| `level` | `number` | The level threshold to check against |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `hasLevel` | `boolean` | Whether the skill's level is equal to or greater than the specified level |

### CheckSkillPerk

Check if a skill has a specific perk unlocked

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:CheckSkillPerk(skillData, skillID, perkID)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `skillData` | `table<string, PMMSkillData>\|PMMSkillData\|nil` | The skill data object |
| `skillID` | `string` | The unique identifier of the skill |
| `perkID` | `number\|string` | The perk id (the level of the perk, e.g. `3`) |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `hasPerk` | `boolean` | Whether the skill has the specified perk unlocked |

### GetSkillPerkChoice

Get the choice made when unlocking a perk that has `choices` in the config

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:GetSkillPerkChoice(skillData, skillID, perkID)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `skillData` | `table<string, PMMSkillData>\|PMMSkillData\|nil` | The skill data object |
| `skillID` | `string` | The unique identifier of the skill |
| `perkID` | `number\|string` | The unique identifier of the perk |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `choice` | `string\|nil` | The chosen key (e.g. "desert"), nil if the perk has not been unlocked |

## Job Exports (require bcc-society)

### GetCombinedSkillsForJob

Get the best level of each skill among the members of a job

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:GetCombinedSkillsForJob(jobName)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `jobName` | `string` | The job name |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `skills` | `table<string, number>` | Best level per skill id |

### CheckJobSkillLock

Check that the members of a job, together, reach the required level in every skill

```lua
exports.pmm_skill_system:CheckJobSkillLock(jobName, requirements)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `jobName` | `string` | The job name |
| `requirements` | `table<string, number>` | Required level per skill id, e.g. `{ blacksmithing = 3 }` |

| Returns | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `satisfied` | `boolean` | Whether every requirement is met |
